title: ExtrinSplat: Decoupling Geometry and Semantics for Open-Vocabulary Understanding in 3D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: arXiv:2509.22225v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Lifting 2D open-vocabulary understanding into 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) scenes is a critical challenge. Mainstream methods, built on an embedding paradigm, suffer from three key flaws: (i) geometry-semantic inconsistency, where points, rather than objects, serve as the semantic basis, limiting semantic fidelity; (ii) semantic bloat from injecting gigabytes of feature data into the geometry; and (iii) semantic rigidity, as one feature per Gaussian struggles to capture rich polysemy. To overcome these limitations, we introduce ExtrinSplat, a framework built on the extrinsic paradigm that decouples geometry from semantics. Instead of embedding features, ExtrinSplat clusters Gaussians into multi-granularity, overlapping 3D object groups. A Vision-Language Model (VLM) then interprets these groups to generate lightweight textual hypotheses, creating an extrinsic index layer that natively supports complex polysemy. By replacing cos

translated_title: ExtrinSplat：解耦几何与语义以实现3D高斯泼溅中的开放词汇理解
translated_abstract: 将2D开放词汇理解提升到3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）场景中是一个关键挑战。主流方法基于嵌入范式，存在三个关键缺陷：（i）几何-语义不一致，即点而非对象作为语义基础，限制了语义保真度；（ii）语义膨胀，即向几何中注入数吉字节的特征数据；（iii）语义僵化，即每个高斯一个特征难以捕捉丰富的多义性。为克服这些限制，我们引入了ExtrinSplat，这是一个基于外在范式构建的框架，将几何与语义解耦。ExtrinSplat不嵌入特征，而是将高斯聚类成多粒度、重叠的3D对象组。然后，视觉语言模型（VLM）解释这些组以生成轻量级文本假设，创建一个外在索引层，天然支持复杂多义性。通过替换余弦相似度计算，ExtrinSplat显著减少了存储需求，同时增强了语义保真度，在多个基准测试中实现了最先进的性能，并展示了在复杂场景中的高效推理能力。
tldr: ExtrinSplat通过外在范式将几何与语义解耦，利用高斯聚类和视觉语言模型生成轻量级文本索引，解决了3D高斯泼溅中语义不一致、膨胀和僵化的问题，实现了高效且高保真的开放词汇理解。
en_tdlr: ExtrinSplat decouples geometry from semantics via an extrinsic paradigm, using Gaussian clustering and vision-language models to generate lightweight text indices, addressing semantic inconsistency, bloat, and rigidity in 3D Gaussian Splatting for efficient and high-fidelity open-vocabulary understanding.
